newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real rises 0.02 percent in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real rises 0.02 percent in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.02 percent to close at 1.0580 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading, dealers said.
Although the Central Bank lowered the reais-dollar mini- band on Monday to between 1.0575 and 1.0625 reais per dollar, the local currency stayed firm on dollar inflows, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a $45 million surplus on Monday.
The market had been expecting a decline of 0.10 percent in the mini-band, but the Central Bank lowered it by just 0.05 percent on Monday. It was April's first decline in the mini- band.
The previous mini-band was set on March 31 at between 1.0570 and 1.0620 reais per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0640 reais per dollar, down 0.01 percent. In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.130 reais per dollar.
